510k number: The unique identifier assigned to the 510(k) submission
regulation section: The specific FDA regulation section governing the device
purpose for submission: The reason for the submission, such as new device or modification
classification: The regulatory classification of the device (e.g., Class I, II, III)
product code: The FDA product code assigned to the device
applicant: The name of the company or entity submitting the 510(k)
type of test: The classification of the test, such as quantitative or qualitative
intended use: The description of the intended use and indication for use of the device
measurand: The specific analyte or substance being measured by the device
panel: The clinical chemistry panel or category the device belongs to
test principle: The scientific principle or method used by the device to perform the test
predicate device name: The name of the predicate device used for substantial equivalence comparison
special conditions for use: Any special conditions or restrictions for using the device
predicate 510k number: The 510(k) number of the predicate device
proprietary and established names: The commercial and generic names of the device or assay
conclusion: The final decision or summary of the substantial equivalence determination
special instrument requirements: Specific instruments required to operate the device
indication for use: Detailed indications for use for each component of the device
measuring range: The range of values the device can accurately measure
limit of quantitation: The lowest concentration of the analyte that can be quantified with acceptable precision
